page_topic_one_liner: External (outbound) links SEO — authority signals, E-E-A-T citations, rel attribute management, and UX best practices
differentiator_vs_generic: This is traditional SEO outbound-link strategy, NOT GEO/LLM chat. Hero must show an article page with a visible outbound link arrow leaving the site to an external authoritative domain — NOT a backlink acquisition dashboard or AI panel.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): article page mockup on current domain (example.com) with one highlighted outbound hyperlink in body text — accent-colored arrow or dashed line exiting page boundary toward external domain box (authority-site blur)
Secondary: three-domain link-type diagram — same-site internal arrows, outbound arrow leaving center site, inbound arrow entering from third site (minimal blurred domain labels)
Tertiary: rel attribute chip row — nofollow / sponsored / ugc as small colored badges (blurred, no readable attribute text labels on canvas)
anti_patterns: LLM chat panel as hero (this is outbound link SEO not GEO)
Backlink builder or link-exchange spam dashboard
Generic chain-link icon without page context
Affiliate commission UI unrelated to citation strategy

en.headline: EXTERNAL LINKS
en.subtitle: Outbound Links & Authority
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for external/outbound link SEO guide. HERO: blog article page mockup on example.com occupying right two-thirds — blurred paragraph with one blue underlined outbound link highlighted, dashed accent klein-blue arrow leaving page edge to external authority domain box. Secondary: three-site link ecosystem mini-diagram showing internal, outbound, and inbound arrow directions. Tertiary: three small rel badge chips (nofollow, sponsored, ugc) as color blocks only. Title block top-left. Paper collage torn edges, halftone. NO LLM chat UI, NO Ahrefs/Moz logos, NO link spam tools, NO extra text labels.
